notice: These ministry names and placements are fictional examples for exploring the design. They are not confirmed partners or open positions.

ministries.name: Athens Welcome House
ministries.summary: Help newcomers find welcome, connection, and practical support.
ministries.role: Language practice, welcoming activities, resource preparation, and support for a supervised community program.
ministries.support: Work alongside a local coordinator; language support and boundaries would be agreed before placement.

ministries.name: The Open Table
ministries.summary: Build relationships around meals and consistent, practical care.
ministries.role: Prepare meal supplies, support community outreach, and help the team organize donations.
ministries.support: Join staff-led outreach; the host team would set the role and provide orientation.

ministries.name: The Learning Garden
ministries.summary: Support a community where children can learn and belong.
ministries.role: Prepare learning resources, assist trained educators, and support supervised creative activities.
ministries.support: Child-facing work would require host approval, appropriate screening, and supervised responsibilities.

ministries.name: Safe Harbor Collective
ministries.summary: Support the practical work behind a place of safety and dignity.
ministries.role: Help with supplies, administration, communications, and staff-led community activities.
ministries.support: Specialist care remains with qualified staff. The host would agree suitable roles and confidentiality requirements.

ministries.name: The Neighborhood Room
ministries.summary: Make space for conversation, shared meals, and neighborhood connection.
ministries.role: Assist a community café, prepare outreach materials, and help coordinate volunteer activities.
ministries.support: Build a consistent rhythm with a local supervisor and agreed learning goals.

ministries.name: Rainforest Roots Ministry
ministries.summary: Learn alongside a community-led ministry serving families.
ministries.role: Support learning activities, prepare materials, and assist practical community projects.
ministries.support: Activities would follow locally identified priorities and the host’s supervision arrangements.

ministries.name: Creative Welcome
ministries.summary: Bring creativity to activities that help families feel welcome.
ministries.role: Assist with art and language activities and prepare resources for supervised family programs.
ministries.support: The host would confirm language expectations and screening for family-facing work.

ministries.name: Camp & Community Project
ministries.summary: Use practical skills to support a ministry’s everyday work.
ministries.role: Assist with program preparation, facilities projects suited to your skills, and supervised group activities.
ministries.support: Project scope, equipment training, and supervision would be agreed before arrival.
